scripts.check:headless: pnpm -s run setup:headless && pnpm -s run check
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:no-no-memo && pnpm run lint:assistant-run-id-producer && pnpm run lint:mastra-stream-chunk-contract && pnpm run lint:browser-events-literals && pnpm run lint:catalog-user-choice && pnpm run lint:e2e-destructive-tags && pnpm run lint:e2e-readiness-contracts && pnpm run lint:mastra-schema-init-order && pnpm run lint:no-source-cycles && pnpm run lint:model-catalog-migrations && pnpm run lint:package-build-strategies && pnpm run lint:tsup-build-invariants && pnpm run lint:minimum-release-age-exclusions && pnpm run arch:domain-contract && pnpm run arch:domain-boundaries && pnpm run lint:eslint && biome check . --fix
scripts.lint:ci: pnpm run lint:no-no-memo && pnpm run lint:assistant-run-id-producer && pnpm run lint:mastra-stream-chunk-contract && pnpm run lint:browser-events-literals && pnpm run lint:catalog-user-choice && pnpm run lint:e2e-destructive-tags && pnpm run lint:e2e-readiness-contracts && pnpm run lint:mastra-schema-init-order && pnpm run lint:no-source-cycles && pnpm run lint:model-catalog-migrations && pnpm run lint:package-build-strategies && pnpm run lint:tsup-build-invariants && pnpm run lint:minimum-release-age-exclusions && pnpm run arch:domain-contract && pnpm run arch:domain-boundaries && pnpm run lint:eslint && biome check .
scripts.lint:eslint: eslint --max-warnings=341 apps/desktop/src apps/web/src packages/app-shell/src packages/app-state/src packages/assistant-ui/src packages/db-explorer/src packages/db/src packages/file-explorer-hooks/src packages/file-explorer-ui/src packages/file-import/src packages/hooks/src packages/notes-vault/src packages/settings-ui/src packages/token-cache/src packages/ui/src packages/vector-management/src packages/workspace-search/src
scripts.test: node scripts/run-env.mjs TURBO_TEST_MODE=unit TEST_TIMEOUT_MULTIPLIER=2 -- node scripts/run-turbo-command.mjs --windows-concurrency=1 -- run test --concurrency=4 --summarize --log-order=grouped && node scripts/run-env.mjs TURBO_TEST_MODE=unit TEST_TIMEOUT_MULTIPLIER=2 -- node scripts/run-turbo-command.mjs --windows-concurrency=1 -- run test:integration --concurrency=2 --summarize --log-order=grouped
scripts.test:browser: node scripts/run-env.mjs TEST_TIMEOUT_MULTIPLIER=2 -- node scripts/run-turbo-command.mjs -- run test:browser --summarize --log-order=grouped
scripts.test:coverage: node scripts/run-env.mjs TURBO_TEST_MODE=coverage COVERAGE=true TEST_TIMEOUT_MULTIPLIER=2 -- node scripts/run-turbo-command.mjs --windows-concurrency=1 -- run test:coverage --filter='!@brainstrike/db' --concurrency=4 --summarize --log-order=grouped
scripts.test:coverage:base: node scripts/run-env.mjs TURBO_TEST_MODE=coverage COVERAGE=true TEST_TIMEOUT_MULTIPLIER=2 -- pnpm -r --filter '!@brainstrike/db' --filter '!@brainstrike/embeddings' run test:coverage
scripts.test:coverage:embeddings: node scripts/run-env.mjs TURBO_TEST_MODE=coverage COVERAGE=true TEST_TIMEOUT_MULTIPLIER=2 -- pnpm --filter @brainstrike/embeddings run test:coverage
scripts.test:coverage:split: pnpm run test:coverage:base && pnpm run test:coverage:embeddings
scripts.test:e2e:local-db: node scripts/run-env.mjs LOCAL_FIRST_DB=true EMBED_QUEUE_ENABLED=true -- pnpm test:e2e
scripts.test:fast: node scripts/run-env.mjs TEST_TIMEOUT_MULTIPLIER=2 -- pnpm -r run test && node scripts/run-env.mjs TEST_TIMEOUT_MULTIPLIER=2 -- pnpm -r run test:integration
